response.rationale: The item is defective (sole peeling from fabric) and not final sale, so RET-020 (priority 90) applies and grants eligibility regardless of the standard window. RET-007 (standard 30-day window) also supports eligibility since it's within 9 days and not final sale, but RET-020 is the controlling highest-priority applicable rule. Final-sale rule RET-012 does not apply (final_sale is false), and no fraud hold is present.
